lesson.title: One wire everyone shares
lesson.goal: The hubs are gone and the switch has learned where all three PCs sit

step.text: Ping PC1 from PC0, then open the events and read the hub's line: the frame is repeated to every port, so everyone hears everything.
The two chained hubs make one shared wire, and two frames at once collide on it. Delete both hubs; the spare switch above will take over.
Cable PC0, PC1 and PC2 to free ports on Switch0.
Ping around the triangle so every PC speaks once, then run show mac address-table on Switch0: it remembers which port each PC sits behind and repeats nothing it does not have to.

check.label: PC1 reaches PC2 through the switch
PC2 reaches PC0 through the switch
Switch0 has learned all three PCs
